evidence.note: After first build the agent wrote /tmp/check.py which runs the actual compiled server against golden.jsonl and produces a PER-METHOD pass-rate breakdown (selectionRange 10%, folding 36%, references 63%, etc.), turning the opaque aggregate into localized diagnostics. run_tests.sh is used as the outer loop (~30 runs across steps 28-263).

Built /tmp/diff.py, a per-triple expected-vs-actual diff tool invoked with method+file filters (e.g. textDocument/hover on a specific file), letting it pinpoint the exact divergent field — e.g. discovering a missing '...' varargs token from field-level output.

Diffing drives field/position-level fixes: identifies selectionRange chain has extra class_body node, folding endLine off-by-one, reference range including receiver (col 38 vs 43), documentSymbol kind 8 vs 14 (Constant). Feeds specific single files/methods through the real binary to isolate the divergent field.

Regression awareness: notices codeLens dropped 99.4->96.3, documentHighlight regressed 95.6->95.0, and reverts an overload-disambiguation change that caused a slight regression — reactive regression guarding via the per-method breakdown, though not an engineered guard harness.

reasoning: The agent engineered a tight verification workflow well beyond a pass/fail number: reusable scripts giving per-method pass rates and per-triple expected-vs-actual field-level diffs, run against the real compiled server on isolated single files/methods to pinpoint exact divergent fields and positions — squarely the anchor-8 description. It shows some level-10 traits (reactively catching and reverting regressions from the breakdown, sustained across the whole suite from step 29 to 264) but lacks a formally engineered regression-guard harness, so it stops short of 10.
